lines.beaver: 이사 온 지 일주일째예요. 이 동네 안전해요?
lines.beaver_en: It's been a week since I moved in. Is this area safe?
lines.beaver_roman: Isa on ji iljuiljjaeyeyo. I dongne anjeonhaeyo?
lines.learner: 네, 다른 동네에 비해 폭력 사건이 적어요.
lines.en: Yes, there's less violence compared to other areas.
lines.roman: Ne, dareun dongnee bihae pongnyeok sakkeoni jeogeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: That's a relief. What about theft?
lines.learner: 도난은 가끔 있어요. 작년에 자전거 도난이 많았어요.
lines.en: Theft happens sometimes. Lots of bikes were stolen last year.
lines.roman: Donaneun gakkeum isseoyo. Jangnyeone jajeongeo donani manasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: No wonder there are so many locks. Was the culprit caught?
lines.en: Yes, the culprit was caught last month.

lines.beaver_en: Do you see the police often?
lines.learner: 네, 요즘 경찰이 밤마다 순찰을 돌아요.
lines.en: Yes, these days the police patrol every night.
lines.roman: Ne, yojeum gyeongchari bammada sunchareul dorayo.

lines.beaver_en: But I heard phone scams are common lately.
lines.learner: 맞아요. 폭력에 비해서 사기가 훨씬 많아요.
lines.en: Right. Fraud is far more common compared to violence.
lines.roman: Majayo. Pongnyeoge bihaeseo sagiga hwolssin manayo.

lines.beaver_en: I know. My mother almost got scammed too.
lines.en: You should always be on guard with unknown numbers.

lines.beaver_en: I heard there's a military base nearby.
lines.learner: 네, 군부대가 있어서 오히려 안전한 편이에요.
lines.en: Yes, there's a military base, so it's actually fairly safe.
lines.roman: Ne, gunbudaega isseoseo oheryeo anjeonhan pyeonieyo.

lines.beaver_en: Having a military base must feel reassuring.
lines.learner: 군과 경찰이 함께 동네를 지켜서 든든해요.
lines.en: The military and police guard the area together, so I feel secure.
lines.roman: Gungwa gyeongchari hamkke dongnereul jikyeoseo deundeunhaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Where should I go in an emergency?
lines.en: In an emergency, you can go to the community center.

lines.beaver_en: Thanks to you, I feel reassured. Thank you.
lines.en: Not at all. It's nicer to live here than other areas.
